en: Why are my notifications not showing?
Why can't I see my notifications?
hi: mere notifications show nahi ho rahe hain
mujhe notifications nahi mil rahe hain
main notifications nahi dekh pa raha hoon
notification kaam nahi kar raha hai

answers.en: Please refresh the dashboard and check your notification section again. If notifications are still missing, contact the support team so they can check your account.
answers.or: Dayakari dashboard refresh kari notification section puni check kara. Jadi tathapi notification missing achhi, support team ku contact kara.
answers.hi: Kripya dashboard refresh karke notification section dobara check karein. Agar notifications phir bhi missing hain, to support team se contact karein.
answers.mixed: Dashboard refresh kari notification section puni check kara. Jadi notification tathapi asuni, support team ku contact kara.

en: Will I get a notification when my task unlocks?
How will I know when a task is unlocked?
Do I get notified about task updates?
Will I receive a task notification?
or: task unlock hele notification asiba ki
task unlock hela boli kemiti janibi
task update pain notification miliba ki
hi: task unlock hone par notification milega kya
task unlock hua hai kaise pata chalega
task update ka notification milega kya
mixed: task unlock hele notification asiba ki
task unlock hela boli kemiti janibi
task update ra notification miliba ki

answers.en: The platform can send notifications for relevant task updates, including task progression events. You can also check the task status from your dashboard.
answers.or: Platform relevant task update pain notification deipare, including task progression events. Tume dashboard ru task status madhya check karipariba.
answers.hi: Platform relevant task updates ke liye notifications bhej sakta hai, including task progression events. Aap dashboard se task status bhi check kar sakte hain.
answers.mixed: Platform relevant task updates pain notification deipare. Dashboard ru task status madhya check karipariba.

answers.en: Support conversation updates can appear through the support conversation and notification system. Open Help & Support to check the latest messages.
answers.or: Support conversation update support conversation au notification system madhyama re asipare. Latest message check karibaku Help & Support open kara.
answers.hi: Support conversation updates support conversation aur notification system ke through aa sakte hain. Latest messages check karne ke liye Help & Support open karein.
answers.mixed: Support conversation updates notification system madhyama re asipare. Latest message pain Help & Support open kara.
